title: Extended Admissible Dissections of Marked Surfaces and Piano Algebras
summary: We introduce the notion of extended admissible dissections of a marked surface, building upon the notion of an admissible dissection of a marked surface by Amiot--Plamondon--Schroll. For each extended admissible dissection we construct a differential graded algebra, called a piano algebra, which may be viewed in some sense as a differential graded analogue of a gentle algebra.
